detail.longDescription: Instinct, a one-year-old AI assistant startup founded by a 23-year-old, has raised 350M USD in Series B funding at a 2.5B USD valuation. The agent can organise users' lives by connecting to apps and devices, handling tasks from planning road trips to cancelling subscriptions. The company is currently in private beta. https:// techcrunch.com/2026/08/26/vira l-ai-startup-instinct-has-raised-350-million-at-a-2-5-billion-valuation/ # AIagent # AI # GenAI # AgenticAI
